source.label: Data East Secret Service operations manual

strategy.overview: Secret Service starts two-ball Multiball from the White House lock and timed five-bank, while the target grid and KGB Hideout lead to three-ball Multiball. For two-ball play, lock at the White House ramp, then complete the timed five-bank. For three-ball play, complete the three standups to light a grid row; hitting the currently flashing target first can light the row immediately. Shoot the raised KGB Hideout to lock and start it.
strategy.simpleOverview: For two-ball Multiball, lock a ball from the ramp in the White House, then complete the timed five-bank. For three-ball Multiball, complete the three standups, or hit the flashing one first, to light a grid row, then shoot the raised KGB Hideout. During three-ball play, shoot the ramp for Jackpots.
strategy.summary: Lock at the White House ramp and finish the timed five-bank for two-ball Multiball. Or light a grid row with the three standups, then shoot the raised KGB Hideout for three-ball Multiball. Shoot the ramp for three-ball Jackpots.

quickInfo.name: Start 2-Ball
quickInfo.summary: Lock at the White House ramp, then complete the timed five-bank.

quickInfo.name: Light KGB Hideout
quickInfo.summary: Hit all three grid-row standups. When one flashes, hit that standup first to light the row immediately.

quickInfo.name: Start 3-Ball
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the raised KGB Hideout after a grid row is lit.

quickInfo.name: Score Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the ramp during three-ball Multiball.

steps.text: Shoot the ramp to lock a ball in the White House.
With that ball locked, complete the timed five-bank to begin instant two-ball Multiball.
For three-ball Multiball, complete the three standups to light a grid row; hit the currently flashing standup first to light the row at once when offered.
Shoot the raised KGB Hideout to lock the ball and immediately start three-ball Multiball.
During three-ball Multiball, shoot the ramp for the Jackpot and the Hideout for its lit values.

alternatives.title: Start timed 2x
alternatives.when: Use this during two-ball play when a controlled feature shot is available.

steps.text: During two-ball Multiball, shoot the ramp, Spy Bar, or ball eater to start timed 2x scoring.
Spend the multiplier on repeat ramp and spinner shots before the timer expires.
Roll through an inlane to light the opposite Super Spinner and raise the center up-post.
Shoot the lit spinner while the return protection is active.
Return to the three standups whenever their flashing shortcut offers a fast KGB Hideout qualification.

machineSetup: Confirm five-bank timer, grid-row, Jackpot, and extra-ball settings before competitive play.
Test the White House ramp and lock, timed five-bank, three standups and lamps, KGB Hideout lift and ball eater, Spy Bar, inlanes, spinners, and up-post.

cautions.issue: The five-bank route is timed after the White House lock.
cautions.response: Do not take the lock until the target bank is reset and you are ready to attack it immediately.
